mapper.select: select id, response_minutes, arrival_minutes, finish_minutes from wo_sla_rule where (category_id = #{categoryId} or category_id is null) and urgency_level = #{urgencyLevel} and effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} and (effective_to is null or effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by case when category_id = #{categoryId} then 1 else 0 end desc, priority desc, effective_from desc, id desc limit 1
